sourceSentences: [0] You can put a minion between you and Tahm Kench in order to dodge his Q. As soon as he uses his E, disengage and wait for his shield to fade.
[0] Do not try head to head fight with him, he is better at long trades so keep your trades very short or just push your lane and try to win the minion war.
[0] Q him when he gets closer and W if he tries to eat you/your adc.
[0] Stand behind minions to avoid his Q. Not much else to say, poke away.
[0] Make sure you won't get hit by him 3 times because of his passive. But you can harass him a lot.
[1] Tahm Kench has no means of dealing ranged damage aside from his Tongue Lash (Q).
[1] Lulu will have complete control over lane if she avoids his Tongue Lash(Q). However, the slow on Tongue Lash(Q) makes it a threat if Lulu is hit with it when Tahm Kench is close by.
[2] Kill Lulu if she stands too close by hitting her with Tongue Lash [Q] to slow her and following up with basic attacks.
[2] However, Lulu’s Whimsy (W) and Help, Pix (E) make her difficult to deal with.
[2] Most Lulu users will use Glitterlance (Q) and basic attacks to contest lane from a distance, so try to pull lane to avoid being punished.
